ai_misc.desc:
**AI chat assistant**
💬 {ai} `<message>` — Chat with the AI
🗑️ {ai_clear} — Clear the conversation history
📜 {ai_history} — View the conversation log

**Report system**
🚨 {report} — Report a rule-breaking message (AI-assisted)

**Dynamic voice channels**
🔊 {dynamic_voice_setup} — Set up dynamic voice channels; a private room is created automatically on join

**Feedback**
📝 {feedback} — Send feedback to the developer

**Bot customization**
🖼️ {change_avatar} / {change_banner} / {change_bio} — Customize the bot's appearance (requires authorization)
ai_misc.title: 🤖 AI Chat & More

automod_autopublish.desc:
Let the bot manage your server automatically.

**AutoMod**
• {automod_view} — View the current AutoMod settings
• {automod_toggle} — Turn AutoMod on or off
• {automod_settings} — Adjust what AutoMod detects
• Can auto-detect: punishment evasion, mention spam, scam links, and more

**AutoPublish**
• {autopublish_settings} — Configure the auto-publish channel
• The bot automatically publishes announcement channel messages to all following servers
automod_autopublish.title: 🤖 AutoMod & AutoPublish

autoreply.desc:
Set up keyword-triggered auto-reply messages.

➕ {autoreply_add} `<keyword> <reply>` — Add an auto-reply
➖ {autoreply_remove} `<keyword>` — Remove an auto-reply
📋 {autoreply_list} — List all auto-replies
✏️ {autoreply_edit} — Edit an existing auto-reply
⚡ {autoreply_quickadd} — Quickly add multiple replies
📤 {autoreply_export} — Export replies as JSON
📥 {autoreply_import} — Import replies from JSON
🧪 {autoreply_test} — Test an auto-reply trigger

-# Supports chance-based triggers and variable substitution
autoreply.title: 💬 Auto-Reply

basic_info.desc:
These commands give you quick info about the bot and the server.

🏓 {info_ping} — Check the bot's latency (Websocket & REST API)
ℹ️ {info_bot} — Show the bot's version, server count, uptime, and more
📋 {info_changelog} — View the bot's changelog
📝 {info_commits} — Show recent Git commits
📈 {stats} — View command usage stats
basic_info.title: 📊 Basic Info Commands

completed.desc:
Congrats, you've finished the bot tutorial! 🎉

**Quick recap:**
• Use {info_help} to see all commands
• Use {info_help} `<command>` for details on a specific command
• Use {info_bot} to view bot info
• Use {feedback} to send feedback to the developer

**Links:**
If you run into any issues, join the [support server]({support_url}) for help!

-# Have fun! — by AvianJay
completed.title: ✅ Tutorial Complete!

economy.desc:
A full virtual economy system with currency, a shop, and trading.

💵 {economy_balance} — Check your balance
📅 {economy_daily} — Claim your daily reward
⏰ {economy_hourly} — Claim your hourly reward
💸 {economy_pay} `<user> <amount>` — Transfer money to another user
🔄 {economy_exchange} — Exchange server currency for global currency
🛒 {economy_shop} — Browse the shop
🛍️ {economy_buy} / {economy_sell} — Buy or sell items
🤝 {economy_trade} — Trade with another user
🏆 {economy_leaderboard} — View the wealth leaderboard
economy.title: 💰 Economy

fun.desc:
A variety of fun commands.

📏 {dsize} — Random measurement... you know 😏
🏆 {dsize_leaderboard} — View the leaderboard
⚔️ {dsize_battle} — Battle another user
🌿 {dsize_feedgrass} — Feed grass
📊 {dsize_stats} — View your stats

🎁 {nitro} — Nitro gift sharing tool
🐾 {petpet} — Generate a petpet GIF
🌐 {explore} — Explore other servers
fun.title: 🎮 Fun Stuff

lookup.desc:
Look up users, servers, and other handy info.

👤 {info_user} `<user>` — Look up a user's ID, creation time, join time, and more
🏠 {info_server} — Look up details about the current server
🖼️ {info_avatar} `[user]` — Get a user's avatar
🎨 {info_banner} `[user]` — Get a user's banner
🎲 {randomnumber} `[min] [max]` — Generate a random number
👥 {randomuser} — Pick a random recent speaker in the channel
📏 {textlength} `<text>` — Count text length
🐱 {httpcat} `<status code>` — Generate a cat image from an HTTP status code
lookup.title: 🔍 Lookup Commands

moderation.desc:
Moderation tools for server admins.

🔨 {ban} `<user> [reason]` — Ban a user
🔓 {unban} `<user>` — Unban a user
👢 {kick} `<user> [reason]` — Kick a user
🔇 {timeout} `<user> <duration>` — Timeout a user
🔊 {untimeout} `<user>` — Remove a timeout
⚡ {multi_moderate} — Moderate multiple users at once

-# Requires the corresponding server moderation permissions
moderation.title: 🛡️ Moderation Tools

music.desc:
Play music in a voice channel.

▶️ {music_play} `<song>` — Play a song or add it to the queue
⏸️ {music_pause} — Pause playback
⏯️ {music_resume} — Resume playback
⏹️ {music_stop} — Stop playback and leave the voice channel
⏭️ {music_skip} — Skip the current song
📜 {music_queue} — View the queue
🎶 {music_now_playing} — Show the current song
🔀 {music_shuffle} — Shuffle the queue
🔊 {music_volume} `<volume>` — Adjust the volume
💡 {music_recommend} — Get a recommendation based on the current song
music.title: 🎵 Music

text_cmd.desc:
Welcome to the bot! Here's a quick overview of what it can do:

📊 **Basic info** — {cmd_ping}, {cmd_info}, {cmd_changelog}, {cmd_stats}
🔍 **Lookup** — `/info user`, `/info server`, `/info avatar`, `/info banner`
🛡️ **Moderation** — `/ban`, `/kick`, `/timeout`, and more
🤖 **AutoMod** — `/automod`, `/autopublish`
💬 **Auto-reply** — `/autoreply add/remove/list`
💰 **Economy** — `/economy balance/daily/shop`, and more
🎵 **Music** — `/music play/pause/skip`, and more
🤖 **AI chat** — `/ai`, `/ai-clear`
🎮 **Fun** — `/dsize`, `/petpet`, `/explore`
📝 **Feedback** — {cmd_feedback}

Use `{prefix}help <command>` for details on a specific command
Use the slash command {cmd_tutorial} for an interactive, paginated tutorial!
text_cmd.title: 📖 Bot Tutorial

welcome.desc:
This is a tutorial to help you quickly get up to speed with everything the bot can do.

**How to use it:**
Use the ⬅️ ➡️ buttons below to flip through the feature pages.

**Command types:**
• **Slash commands** — type `/` and pick from the menu
• **Text commands** — type the prefix (currently `{prefix}`) followed by the command name in chat

**Tip:** use {info_help} or `{prefix}help` any time to see the full command list.
welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to {bot_name}!
